risks: Large file (46 functions). Order MUST match asm exactly; 6 static (non-.public) helpers interleave with public: ov98_0221E9FC, ov98_0221EA4C, ov98_0221EAA8, ov98_0221EC3C, ov98_0221EF14, ov98_0221F174.
9 rodata blocks with tight ordering (_0221F194 ... ov98_0221F248). Static const arrays must emit in declaration order; get F1F8 (u16 2D) vs F220 (s32 thresholds) types right or layout shifts.
Struct-on-stack template copies via ldmia/stmia (E5E0, E7E8, F174) are memcpy of const templates - watch codegen, may be NONMATCHING.
Many thin wrappers (EBD8/EBEC/EC08/EC24 -> EC3C; ED3C -> ED48) with stack-arg forwarding; variadic-looking stack reads mean 5-7 params - wrong param count breaks IPA across shared header.
E6F0/E7E8/E970 mon bitfield decode uses many lsl/lsr - express with explicit masks/shifts, not bitfields, to match.
gSystem+0x48 access (EF24) must match existing SysGlobals field name in include/system.h.
0x1ED (493) is species-count bound (F024, EE28 assert) - Pokedex/dex-graph screen.
notes: Overlay 98 is a stats/graph display screen (Pokedex-completion or ranking graph): a SpriteSystem wrapper (E5E0 ctor / E684 dtor / mon-sprite + icon loaders), a Window+MessageFormat text subsystem (EABC ctor / EB84 dtor + ~10 print helpers keyed on [struct+4] window array with idx<<4 stride), plus math/table helpers (rank lookup EF80/EFA4/EFB4/EFE8, popcount dex counter F024, digit count F150, percentage scale F120) and two gfx teardown routines (F090/F0EC) with a bank-setup helper (F174). Two central structs (0x18 sprite-holder, 0x1c text-holder). No .data/.bss. All thumb.
